    clabs <- NULL

        lwidth <- c(1,3)
    hclust_fun <- function(x) hclust(x, method='complete')
        dist_fun <- function(x) as.dist(1 - cor(t(x)))

ncolors <- 50
    colused <- colorRampPalette(c("#0000ff", "#ffffff", "#ff0000"))(ncolors)

    png(file='/galaxy/server/database/jobs_directory/000/501/outputs/dataset_d8bdecd1-83c5-4014-9a5a-0ae55e29c67d.dat', res=240, height=2000, width=2000)
